findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: larp_check, check_agent, find_job, check_tx, presign_risk_report, stock_token, stock_events, watch_coin, my_watches, watch_wallet · Private data: check_coin, dev_record, wallet_privacy, wallet_approvals, account_permissions, fresh_launches, launch_record, check_agent, find_paid_api, find_job, check_hook, check_tx, presign_risk_report, stock_token, stock_tokens, fundamentals, insider_trades, institutions, guidance, macro, stock_events, ask_toll, watch_coin, my_watches, watch_wallet, unwatch_wallet · Public sink: larp_check, account_permissions, check_tx, presign_risk_report, stock_token, fundamentals, guidance, watch_coin · Destructive: find_job, ask_toll, unwatch_coin, unwatch_wallet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: larp_check, check_agent, find_job, check_tx, presign_risk_report, stock_token, stock_events, watch_coin, my_watches, watch_wallet · Private data: check_coin, dev_record, wallet_privacy, wallet_approvals, account_permissions, fresh_launches, launch_record, check_agent, find_paid_api, find_job, check_hook, check_tx, presign_risk_report, stock_token, stock_tokens, fundamentals, insider_trades, institutions, guidance, macro, stock_events, ask_toll, watch_coin, my_watches, watch_wallet, unwatch_wallet · Public sink: larp_check, account_permissions, check_tx, presign_risk_report, stock_token, fundamentals, guidance, watch_coin · Destructive: find_job, ask_toll, unwatch_coin, unwatch_wallet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
